messageCenterItems.title: Microsoft Teams: Registration capacity for town halls and webinars increases to 20,000
messageCenterItems.summary: Starting December 2026, Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars registration capacity scales with attendee limits, up to 20,000 registrations per event. Teams Enterprise allows 3,000; Attendee Capacity Packs allow up to 20,000. Rollout occurs from mid-December 2026 to late January 2027. No action required.
messageCenterItems.body:
Updated November 23, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience. 

What and why

Starting in December, registration capacity for Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars scales with the event's attendee capacity, up to 20,000 registrations per event. Organizers with Teams Enterprise can allow up to 3,000 registrations. Organizers with Attendee Capacity Packs can allow up to 20,000. Organizers can use this to plan large-scale events with registration.

Rollout schedule

  • Public Preview: We will begin rolling out on mid-December 2026 and expect to complete by late December 2026.
  • General Availability (Worldwide): We will begin rolling out in early January 2027 and expect to complete by late January 2027.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizers of Teams town halls and webinars that use registration
  • Admins who manage Teams events policies and Attendee Capacity Pack licenses

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams (town halls and webinars)

What will happen

  • Registration capacity scales with attendee capacity, up to 20,000 registrations per event.
  • Organizers with Teams Enterprise can allow up to 3,000 registrations.
  • Organizers with Attendee Capacity Packs can allow up to 20,000 registrations.
  • Large webinars with registration don't support broadcast-style streaming, which is available with town halls.
  • Organizers still need the right events policy. No new policy access is needed, only the right Attendee Capacity Pack where applicable.
  • Existing Teams events policies and admin controls don't change.
  • We plan to support more registrations per event in future releases.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required. To prepare, you can:

  • Tell organizers about the higher registration limits.
  • Make sure organizers who need more than 3,000 registrations per event have an Attendee Capacity Pack of the right size. Assign packs in the Teams admin center (Add-on Licenses > Teams Events).
  • Update internal training and documentation that mention a 1,000-registration limit.
  • Review your Teams events policies in the Teams admin center (Meetings > Events policies) to confirm they meet your organization's needs.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
